title: Introducing Personal Agent Optimization
summary: See which product AI agents pick when they shop for your customers.
body_markdown:
**See which product AI agents pick when they shop for your customers.**


Today, we’re launching Personal Agent Optimization by The Prompting Company.


You already track how ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity answer questions about your category. Now shoppers are handing the whole job to personal agents: compare the offers, pick one, and take me there. The agent decides which stores to visit and which product to recommend, often before the shopper sees a single product page.


Personal Agent Optimization shows you what those agents do. Two personal agents, Grok Bot and Muse, ask your prompts in their own browsers, and TPC shows which product their answers land on.


## How it works


- **Pick a product.**


Tell the agents what to shop for.


- **Review the prompts.**


TPC writes them from your product. Edit, add, or remove any of them before launch.


- **Watch them shop.**


Follow every agent live in its own browser and see the product it ends on.


## What you see


- **Which product each agent picks.**


Every answer adds up to a share of picks across your product and its competitors.


- **The sources behind the pick.**


The sites each answer cited when it chose a product.


- **Where each engine looks.**


The kinds of sites each agent relies on, from stores to reviews.


It’s the same loop we run for AI search: track the prompts your customers ask, see what the agents recommend, and fix what keeps you from being picked.


## The research behind it


Before building this, we studied how personal agents shop: 11,200 runs across 1,255 prompts with Grok Bot, Muse, Instinct, and Dots. In three of its shopping tests, agents favored the lower unit price, broke ties on stock labels, and often skipped a store that charged for shipping when another didn’t.


Read the write-up in


[How personal agents choose what to buy](https://promptingcompany.com/blog/how-personal-agents-choose-what-to-buy) , or explore the


[full dataset](https://promptingcompany.com/research/how-personal-agents-choose) .


## Get started


Personal agents are included on every plan. Basic includes Grok Bot, Pro adds Muse, and White-glove adds Dots and Instinct.
